name: Balance on one leg for 20 seconds
short_description: Maintain a one-leg stance for 20 seconds near stable support.
self_assessment: I can balance on either leg for 20 seconds without holding support.
description: Maintain a one-leg stance for 20 seconds near stable support. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Hold a one-leg stance beside a wall
